summary: Current OpenAI docs as of 2026-09-06 describe GPT-6 Astra as OpenAI's most capable / most intelligent model, with state-of-the-art performance in software engineering, computer use, browsing, science, and professional work. So yes: for Codex-style end-to-end coding/agent work, Astra is currently the top OpenAI model overall, though availability is still rolling out and task-specific smaller models may be faster/cheaper.
